# Paper Mono

Upstream: https://github.com/paper-design/paper-mono
Release: v1.000
Commit: e6eaeceaef02e77e3db997711e07a16378de2bd7

`PaperMono.woff2` contains the unmodified upstream bytes from
`fonts/webfonts/PaperMono[wght].woff2` at this commit.
SHA-256: `34bf2cb064a77b2b966063b17887e50d71f9fb61481af67444eaf91561cf6327`

`OFL.txt` contains the unmodified upstream licence at this commit.
SHA-256: `ae8bcaf5a046be7e096b5710a8532cdaa5a299462e182752b805dcfa44370e4c`

The variable font supports normal weights 100–800. It has no italic axis.
Its PostScript name is `PaperMono-Regular`; its full name is `Paper Mono Regular`.
The static Regular has the same names. The IDE declares exact local weights
before the variable WOFF2 fallback to avoid treating static Regular as a range.
The SIL Open Font License 1.1 governs these files. No local conversion was made.
